title: USB Audio Out (tracks)
author: irpina
description: The Octatrack as a 16-channel USB audio input (UAC2, 44.1 kHz, 24-bit) on its own USB port, as a function of usb-ot: tracks 1-8 post-FX before their level at high speed, their stereo sum at full speed. It combines with USB MIDI. One of mods/usb-audio-ot's five layouts.
